subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular `scripts/install.sh` architecture now, and must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact remain a generated or preserved single-file entrypoint?
rationale: This is maintainability cleanup rather than broken behavior, and the current public docs, release artifact, tests, and website sync all assume one served installer script.

options.title: Sponsor guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental module split only with a single public entrypoint, website sync updates, docs alignment, and installer smoke proof.

options.title: Allow opportunistic extraction
options.body: Keep this as backlog guidance and extract sections only when tied to concrete installer bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to reduce helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental module split only with a single public entrypoint, website sync updates, docs alignment, and installer smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The GitHub-main install support work touched the central installer, docs, update path, and tests, making this the best available owner for deciding the split shape.
